init_transformer_pipeline: initialize a TransformerPipeline with a TrainConfig for multi-view image and pose generation training
load_checkpoints: load ImageVAE, PoseVAE, and Transformer2DModel weights from checkpoint files to resume training
eval_step: run a validation step that computes PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics on multi-view samples
forward: run a training forward pass with MSE loss on image and ray prediction using flow matching noise scheduling
sample: generate multi-view images and camera rays from the trained transformer model with optional text conditioning
